articles.title: Two giant dams starved the Danube Delta of sediment for decades
articles.summary: The Danube's sediment supply to its delta has significantly decreased due to upstream engineering works. Large dams like the Iron Gates trap sediment, altering the natural balance of the delta.

articles.title: Owens Slams Erika Kirk: Conservative firebrand alleges ‘biggest betrayer’; rift over Charlie’s legacy
articles.summary: Candace Owens has intensified her public feud with Erika Kirk, claiming Charlie Kirk was “betrayed” and naming his wife as his “biggest betrayer.” Owens said she initially expected Turning Point USA and Erika to help uncover answers after Charlie’s death but later felt shut out. She also alleged that people connected to Erika targeted her.

articles.title: Alleged Auto Theft Booking: US YouTuber reportedly in custody; online campaign backs Brandon’s release
articles.summary: YouTuber Brandon Buckingham was reportedly arrested in Louisiana on an alleged “Theft of Auto/Vehicle” charge, according to a booking notice shared online. The Washington Parish Sheriff's Office was reportedly listed as the booking agency, with no bond set at the time.
